subject: Quick rebook: tighter windows after missed discovery

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@quantify.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@fintegrate.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick rebook & recap — missed discovery today

Hi Alex / Priya —

Sorry we missed each other on the call this morning — I know calendars get messy. Quick note to (1) recap what we intended to cover, and (2) offer a tight set of follow-up windows so we can lock something in quickly. If you can confirm one option by EOD today (or reply with a single preferred time), I will send the calendar invite and bring the right folks.

Recap (what we were planning to cover)
- High-level goals: reduce per-request inference cost and stabilize p95 latency under 200ms for 2k qps.
- Data & security constraints: on-prem connector consideration, E2E encryption, retention policy questions for analytics data.
- Success criteria: 3-week pilot, < $X/token target, and a production-runbook handoff.

Proposed tight windows (20–30m) — all PDT
- Today (Sep 30) 14:00–14:20
- Today (Sep 30) 15:00–15:30
- Tomorrow (Oct 1) 09:00–09:20

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_QuantifyAI_v1.pdf (brief MAP), security-evidence-summary.pdf (SOC2 summary + KMS options).

Ask: please reply with ONE slot (just the time string is fine) so I can lock it. If any legal/compliance folks should join, say so and we will invite them — otherwise we’ll start with a solutions engineer + product lead.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
